hard_failures.finding: The operative quantifier binds the pair (s,delta) over D0, but D0 is defined as a two-member disjunction: 'Sobolev variant s > 5/2 and delta in (1/2,1), or the smooth-with-decay default' (line 58; repeated in regularity.data_regularity line 149 and in the data_class.regularity_class default/sobolev_variant pair at 136-138). The second disjunct supplies no (s,delta) instantiation (probe: smooth_branch_supplies_s_delta_pair=false) and the comeagerness ambient object is defined only for the weighted Sobolev product X^{s,delta}_vac(AF) (line 163; probe: ambient_space_defines_smooth_branch=false). The Frechet topology mentioned at line 164 names a topology but no ambient set / constraint manifold for the smooth-with-decay branch, so 'exists G_{s,delta} subset X^{s,delta}_vac(AF) with G_{s,delta} comeager' (line 47) and conclusion.statement_formal (line 218, 'forall (s,delta) in D0 exists G_{s,delta} comeager') cannot be instantiated for that branch. The artifact is therefore a family of two class statements, not one class statement. This is the same defect the audit lead reopened revision 2 for ('quantifiers.formal still ranges over a disjunctive D0 ... The same fix is required here before accept') and it keeps G-FORM's unmet criterion 'no single frozen data class (s,delta,norm) is shared by F1/F2a/F2b' unsatisfied.

findings.finding: The frozen file repeats the YAML mapping key 'revised_at' eight times (lines 8,10,12,14,16,18,21,23) and carries a ninth variant 'revised_at_unused' (line 26). Duplicate mapping keys are not a YAML error under PyYAML (last-wins, so the parser silently keeps 2026-09-12T00:30:00+08:00) but are rejected by strict YAML 1.2 / yamllint-style parsers, so the revision timestamp of the frozen artifact is parser-dependent and the rev4-rev11 delta comments are attached to keys with no effect. This is not counted as a hard failure because the A0 hard-failure taxonomy has no duplicate-key detector, but it must be fixed (single revised_at plus a revision_log sequence) before the file can be called machine-frozen.
